recent_story_cards.title: The Pencil Beside the Layoff Ballot

recent_story_cards.conflict: A bride must decide whether to proceed when her groom treats understanding their marriage vows as an optional expense.
recent_story_cards.payoff: Take your time.

recent_story_cards.conflict: A cleaner must make an audience understand that her humiliation is real while her employer tries to sell every objection as part of the performance.

recent_story_cards.conflict: A new wife must reject being used as the explanation for a decision her husband made without her consent.

recent_story_cards.twist: The sister believed spreading pieces of the dress through the family justified overriding the bride's plans, but buying a replacement cannot undo that choice.

recent_story_cards.conflict: An absent father must face the daughter he neglected without treating an accidental paid appearance as a claim on reconciliation.

recent_story_cards.twist: The groom hired a stranger because he was ashamed of having nobody to ask, while the hired man's speech about loyalty exposes the relationship he actually abandoned.

recent_story_cards.conflict: An employee must choose whether to protect her boss's invented hero story when his son asks her to repeat it.

recent_story_cards.twist: The supposed disappearance is a voluntary move, and his mother is using strangers' concern to pressure him into returning.

recent_story_cards.payoff: put on her work jacket, and went home.

recent_story_cards.title: The Folder She Was Told to Leave Behind
recent_story_cards.twist: The employee has prepared actual rent figures, while the boss treats her appearance and evening as the business's bargaining tools.

recent_story_cards.title: The Invoice in Her Father's Wedding Envelope
recent_story_cards.twist: The father expects the groom's income to make his daughter collectible, revealing that the wedding is what prompted his demand.
